source_measurement: Huberty et al. 2026 published single-Gaussian FWHM 13.2 +/- 2.0 Angstrom at observed 16004 Angstrom

derived_nonobservational_constraints.note: Width is a second-moment Gaussian equivalent of a two-line blend, not a fit to the real observed line profile. The listed 0.35-1.5 ratios follow density limits; the physical conditional numbers are not likelihoods.

temporal_caveat: Published observed EW > 7620 A uses noncontemporaneous continuum imaging, so rest-frame EW > about 1775 A applies only if the source persisted. Not a bound on a transient emitter.
training_trigger: Compare empirical effective LSF from control emission-line source at ~1.60 micron with a direct convolved doublet likelihood in independently calibrated A-D source spectra.
